description: What needs attention for the person asking: observations OTP has computed about the seats they hold, each with the suggested next actions attached. Returns only their own seats -- never a colleague's, never a direct report's. Answers with what the evaluation engine actually wrote; if it has not run there is nothing to report and the tool says so rather than estimating. ALSO returns openQuestions: things only this person can tell OTP, which it cannot observe. When any are present, say which part of the picture is missing and ask ONE of them conversationally at the end of your answer -- never a list, never all of them, and never before you have answered what they actually asked. Record the reply with answer_coaching_question.

question.description: The person's question in their own words, e.g. 'what should I fix first?'. Steers what to lead with; never changes what exists.

name: my_coaching
